claims: Rabbi Soffer discusses the Mishna on Bechorot daf 56 regarding an animal that was purchased or received as a gift and whether it can be used for Maaser Behemah. (Rabbi Soffer is not mentioned in the transcript)
summary: Rabbi Soffer discusses the Mishna on Bechorot daf 56 regarding an animal that was purchased or received as a gift and whether it can be used for Maaser Behemah. He explains the textual comparisons between Bechor Adam, Bechor animal, and Maaser Behemah, as well as the rules governing fetuses purchased in utero. He also examines a Baraita concerning payment to a Zona and the conditions under which such an animal can enter the pen for Maaser Behemah.
questions: Why does an animal purchased or received as a gift not count for Maaser Behemah?
How does the Torah compare Bechor Adam to animal offerings?
Can ten fetuses bought while in utero be counted for Maaser Behemah after birth?
What is the rule regarding a purchased animal that is a Mechusar Zman?
How does an animal given as payment to a Zona apply to Maaser Behemah?
